component.name: kIRC
component.summary: Chat on IRC with a native KDE client

description.p: kIRC is an IRCv3 client for the KDE Plasma desktop. Its interface is built with Kirigami, so it adapts naturally from a desktop window to a narrow panel or a touch device, and follows your Plasma colours and fonts.

The protocol engine is a Rust core that speaks IRCv3, including message tags, capability negotiation (CAP) and SASL authentication (PLAIN, SCRAM-SHA-256 and EXTERNAL) over TLS, while the presentation layer stays a native Qt Quick application.
Features include multiple server connections, channel and query views, nickname and topic handling, and desktop notifications for highlights through KNotifications.
